'''Dellard Tranc''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Genian (species)|Genian]] who served as [[Talesan Fry]]'s head of Security at Frys [[Fry Industries|business complex]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Tranc was visited by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who had come to negotiate with Fry about the code breakers, which he had developed. Tranc suspected that [[Helina Dow]] was the traitor until he was killed.
